crossRefs.note: The heavens will reveal his iniquity. The earth will rise up against him.
For the stone will cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the woodwork will answer it.
Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out, and the cries of…
The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.

translations.web: If my land cries out against me, and its furrows weep together;
translations.bsb: if my land cries out against me and its furrows weep together,
translations.kjv: If my land cry against me, or that the furrows likewise thereof complain;
translations.asv: If my land crieth out against me, And the furrows thereof weep together;
